## Overview

Plain **Markdown** with a [link](https://example.com), an email [address](mailto:someone@example.com), `inline code` and a keyboard hint: press <Kbd>⌘</Kbd> <Kbd>K</Kbd>. <Badge label="Stable" tone="success" /> <Badge label="0.16.0" />

<Callout kind="tip" title="Try it">
Open a `.smp` file and the language activates on its own.
</Callout>

<Callout>
A note without a title uses the default label.
</Callout>

<Features columns="3">
  <Feature title="Highlighting" icon="brush">
    Strings, numbers and calls in colour.
  </Feature>
  <Feature title="Diagnostics" icon="bug">
    Errors from the language server as you type.
  </Feature>
  <Feature title="Formatting" icon="sparkles">
    Format on save with the bundled formatter.
  </Feature>
</Features>

## Install

<Steps>
  <Step title="Install the server">
    Run the install command below and restart Phantom.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open a file">
    Diagnostics appear after the first save.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Requirement command="sample-language-server" install="brew install sample-language-server" url="https://example.com/server">
Needed for completion, hover and diagnostics.
</Requirement>

<Requirement command="samplefmt">
Optional. Without it, Format on Save is a no-op for this language.
</Requirement>
